design: Retrospective forward event transfer; specifications fixed before inspecting new experiment scores. Events were previously viewed; not preregistered or an untouched prospective test.
limitations: Only two forward test events, one Curve pool; folds and assets are not independent replications.
Events and original model families were previously inspected; no preregistered untouched holdout is claimed.
Frozen pre-event residual intervals can fail coverage under crisis shift; full metrics retained.
No causal identification or structural participant calibration.
Missing or already-known target observations are excluded, not interpolated.
Single-coin LP removal amounts cannot be USD-valued here; counts only.
Gas feature is cutoff-block base fee, not actual transaction gas cost.
